headline: Reliable release verification and readable archive sharing are fully deployed; complete served readback verified.

items.title: Make build-check help safe to inspect
items.insight: Maintainers can discover verification options without starting or mutating a release verification run. Both help aliases print documented options without sanitizing, spawning, locking or changing receipts; normal and self-test lanes remain operational.

items.title: Observe file changes in merge closeouts
items.insight: Maintainers can find the actual last closeout without launching false recovery work. Real merge closeouts produce an observable SIL anchor; subsequent substantive work still becomes debt; live S407 triage can be measured without inventing recovery.

items.title: Preserve complete privacy scanning beyond the default process buffer
items.insight: The privacy guard can scan the complete current source inventory. Its scope and privacy assertions remain unchanged.

items.title: Restore the November archive share image with readable template spacing
items.insight: Sharing the November archive now has a complete branded preview. Shared badge/footer geometry and light-theme ink are verified against rendered pixels.
items.evidence: docs/S408_card-acceptance.json; exact full release remains in docs/RELEASE_S408.json

items.title: Keep complete Git inventories within an explicit shared capture bound
items.insight: Verification and staging retain the full repository inventory within an explicit bounded capture limit. Smaller caller limits and all non-Git defaults remain intact.

followUps: Existing identity/provider, field-vitals and historical optional visual limitations remain separate.
CDR unchanged; the two future SIL commitments remain unselected.
